purpose: PINN and DeepONet pricers for four-stock arithmetic basket options, each built as a ladder: every level adds one technique to the configuration below it, and every level is scored on the same validation contracts. Level names keep the two-stock numbering; levels dropped from the two-stock ladders are absent.
selection_rule: Within each family the level with the lowest validation score is selected. Score = mean over price and the 26 Greeks of RMSE / RMS(reference) on the 4,096 validation contracts drawn from the protocol's training domain. A level within 1% of the best score yields to the earlier level.

computational_domain.note: Spatial extent of the PDE problem in z = log basket forward moneyness and the forward shares s_i >= share_floor (the simplex), like a grid solver's far boundary. The training domain maps into z in [-0.52, 0.46] and shares of at least about 0.04. sigma, the correlation matrices (entries in [-0.5, 0.9], smallest eigenvalue >= 0.05) and the maturity cap are the protocol's training domain; tau starts at 0 because the PDE starts at the payoff.

reference_nodes.note: Conditional Gauss-Hermite nodes per residual axis of the torch reference (src/neural/reference.py): 32 for training labels and anchors, 40 for the monitor and validation contracts. Phase 0 accepted 91% of random domain contracts at 32 nodes and 96% by 40 under the 1e-8 rule.
